description: Unofficial Kel fan-art companion based specifically on the Faraway Town OMORI design. Brown nape-length hair and orange-brown sportswear remain consistent. Original actions include a basketball waist pass, a folding paper basket, shoe-lace warm-up and three-direction running. Opaque short-sleeve underlayer and abstract chest emblem are original adaptations. Friendly fully clothed presentation; not affiliated with OMOCAT.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
